dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Hello there, Traveler. Are you alright? Do you feel unwell anywhere? I'll have a look at it. So, on your back now, just like that...

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: I'm the ship's doctor. Seasickness, wind chills, amputations, I do them all around here.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: You can have full confidence in my skills. If there's anything at all, you can come to me!

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Of course, it's best to stay healthy. But always remember, having too little fear of danger is the most dangerous thing of all!

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: I... When we dock at Liyue Harbor, I often take care of injured cats and the like.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Over time, I've started talking to people in the same way. Please don't take offense.

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: Now that I mention it, I left some small stray kittens in the hands of a Millelith soldier named Yong'an the last time. I wonder how they're doing now...

dialogues.speaker: Yinxing
dialogues.text: So nothing's the matter with you? Great! Keep watching your health!
